summary_responses.subtopic: National Park Administration, Conservation & Multi-Use Trail Regulation
summary_responses.response: The National Park Service (NPS) has amended regulations for Mammoth Cave National Park to permit bicycle use on approximately 37 miles of multi-use trails and to allow horseback riding on the 5.4-mile Houchin Ferry North/Ollie Road. Public comments were considered during the planning process, leading to a Finding of No Significant Impact that supports the selected alternative for trail management.
